validation_unit: One case, one applicable evaluation dimension and one pinned evaluator configuration

partitions.development: Author rules, prompts and evidence roles and select candidate configurations
partitions.calibration: Set abstention and escalation operating points
partitions.sealed_qualification: Apply the frozen complete configuration once and publish every planned assessment
partitions.grouping: Keep shared generation structures and repeated trials from the same historical episode within one split
partitions.legacy_controls: Keep the 26 legacy synthetic templates in a separate comparison stratum

metrics.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of PASS and FAIL F1 over eligible cases, including abstention or invalid output as a missed decision
metrics.business_error_recall: Demonstrated business errors correctly returned as FAIL over eligible business errors
metrics.false_success_recall: Unsupported completion or persistence claims correctly returned as FAIL over eligible false-success cases
metrics.citation_exact_match: Maintain the frozen calculation and gate; report exact sets separately from alternative support
metrics.evidence_semantic_support: Among attempted conclusive outputs, the fraction with valid source references supporting the actual verdict and every dispositive rationale claim
metrics.evidence_sufficiency: Among attempted conclusive outputs, the fraction whose in-scope cited exhibits establish the actual verdict under an independent proof obligation
metrics.coverage: Conclusive schema-valid eligible judgments over all planned eligible judgments
metrics.abstention: Explicit BLOCKED out of planned eligible cases, separately reporting invalid responses and unexecuted cases
metrics.cross_family_agreement: Pairwise Cohen kappa with conclusive pair coverage, plus nominal alpha
metrics.critical_safety: Recall of each critical policy violation family; independently report every critical false PASS
metrics.language_equivalence: Same correct supported conclusive verdict on both sides of a translated pair
metrics.robustness: Matched changes in polarity, citation validity, and sufficiency on invariant transformations, with correct overturns on decisive fact changes
metrics.risk_coverage: Selective error versus decision coverage on the locked calibration operating points, with counts by risk scope
metrics.evaluation_cost: Measured request wall time, end-to-end batch wall time, P50/P95, token use, GPU memory, escalation volume and per-evaluable-unit workload

additional_gate_policy.risk_coverage_and_cost: Report curves and full denominators. Evaluate any call replacement on its own qualified scope.

uncertainty: Report 95% clustered intervals by independent template family or archived episode; keep paired translations and repeated measures together
routing: Require two independently qualified primary families and a third independently qualified dispute family after excluding each subject's family and filtering by dimension and risk
